jobs.occupation: Senior CAPEX Project Manager - Process Industry
jobs.description:
Project overview

As Project Manager, you oversee complex multidisciplinary CAPEX projects in the process industry. You carry full responsibility for scope, budget, planning, quality and safety, covering both greenfield installations and substantial modifications to existing industrial assets.

Primary tasks & responsibilities

• Manage industrial engineering projects from initial concept and feasibility through to commissioning and final transfer to operations.
• Set and control project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate every project stage: pre-study and concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement and contractor selection, construction and on-site execution, commissioning, and operational handover.
• Serve as the main point of accountability for internal stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams spanning mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS domains, in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
• Handle scope changes, risks, claims and deviations that influence budget or timing.
• Provide structured reporting on progress, issues and decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You have at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in fields such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have demonstrated experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval and commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is mandatory.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and take ownership of project planning rather than only follow-up.
• You combine an academic working level with strong analytical capabilities and a helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work independently and take full ownership of your responsibilities.
• You demonstrate strong leadership and are able to challenge stakeholders and contractors when necessary.
• You communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all organisational levels.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial settings.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.
As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.

You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.
You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.

Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.

• Autonomous, proactive, and results-driven.
• Comfortable developing a market and creating business opportunities.
• Experience within technology, software, SaaS, services, or solutions sales is a strong advantage.

You'll be part of a renewable energy consultancy with global reach, focused on creating sustainable solutions for tomorrow. Jobomschrijving

• Maintain and update internal systems and databases (e.g. project tracking, HR and finance tools)

Jobomschrijving

• Process and monitor domestic and international payments.

Our client is an international company headquartered in the Antwerpen region with over 30 years of experience at the international scale. They are looking for an IT Project Manager acting as a primary stakeholder in project coordination (applications and infrastructure) as well as technologies related to SAP within the company.

Jobomschrijving

The IT Project Manager is a key stakeholder in project coordination concerning all IT-related matters within the company. This individual will collaborate with internal business stakeholders and external support partners to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. The role requires a business-focused expert who can advocate for user needs and take the necessary actions for planning and support.

Key responsibilities:

Business System Support:

• 

Act as a super-user and system expert for SAP (ERP), specifically for the S4Hana and Coupa modules (with 80% of the projects being finance-related).
• Understand the architecture and process flows of ERP, Process Control, and related manufacturing systems
• Monitor system health and stability.
• Troubleshoot and address system issues, outages, and functional needs, engaging support partners as needed
• Support business users as a subject matter expert on existing and proposed system functionality
• Act as program manager and project stakeholder for system upgrades and enhancements

End User Support:

• Act as the first responder for user desktop issues (hardware and software), engaging the help desk and support partners as needed.
• Facilitate requests for purchases.
• Observe and anticipate user needs, and make appropriate recommendations for improvement.

Infrastructure, Process and Policy:

• Assist users in understanding IT Policy, Process, and Systems.
• Support business leadership in strategic planning and project oversight.
• Coordinate site activities for upgrades and system maintenance.
• Make recommendations for enhancements that will improve system function, capabilities, and stability.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT or engineering field.
• Proven ability to work across functional and regional boundaries, challenge status quo, and handle multiple projects simultaneously while delivering on time and on budget.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication and change management skills.
• 3-8 years' experience in IT role in a global company.
• Mixed skills should include configuration and expertise in SAP Coupa and S4Hana.

Our client is a leading international FMCG company with a strong portfolio of iconic brands and an established presence in the Belgian retail market.

Jobomschrijving

• Take full ownership of the commercial portfolio.
• Develop and maintain strong strategic customer relationships and act as the key commercial point of contact.
• Lead customer negotiations, Joint Business Plans, contracts and commercial agreements.
• Drive sales growth by identifying new business opportunities and developing customer-specific initiatives.
• Support the Channel Manager in defining sales strategies, commercial targets and promotional policies.
• Develop sales volume budgets and forecasts for assigned customers.
• Monitor customer spending, contractual agreements and commercial investments against budget

• Master's degree in Economics, Marketing, Business or equivalent experience.
• 5-10 years of experience in Sales, Trade Marketing or Key Account Management.
• Strong knowledge of the Belgian retail/FMCG market.
• Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with experience in budgeting, forecasting, business planning and claim management.
• Autonomous and comfortable taking full ownership of customer relationships.
• Strong presentation and communication skills.
• Excellent knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SAP is required.
• Fluent in French and English.

As Technical Lead in the night shift, you will be the team lead of all technical profiles (8 people) in this shift in order to maximize production output while ensuring compliance with defined quality standards. You will coordinate and coach all technical profiles and manages the escalations. More specifically, you will:
 
 
 
• Ensure that equipment performance meets targets and minimize manufacturing failures. 
 
• Support in technical issues on the shop-floor and managing the escalation flow. 
 
• Develop and coach technical personnel to reach higher team results. 
 
• Be responsible for the administration of the personnel in the shift - holidays, sick leaves, transportation, competency review, etc. 
 
• Lead and coordinate escalations with other departments to resolve technical issues promptly. 
 
• Distribute the technical tasks among technical personnel in the shift, setting up team priorities, and making follow-ups on the progress during the shift. 
 
• Participate in improvement projects. Support the recruitment of technical personnel if needed. 
 
• Support / lead the local certification process (depending if there is a training department on site or not). 

Your profile
 
 
 
• Relevant Bachelor degree or Technician with around 5 years of relevant experience.  
 
• Good knowledge of technical coaching principles. 
 
• Excellent communication, team collaboration and targeted mentoring skills. 
 
• Good knowledge of MS office/Google.  
 
• Good understanding of English. 
 
• Ability to use all necessary job-related tools and make precise manual adjustments. 
 
• Analytical, logical, and interpretive mindset for complex technical data. 
 
• Proven ability to lead and coordinate technical activities on a shift or zone level.

jobs.employer_name: YOUNG UNIVERSITIES FOR THE FUTURE OF EUROPE (YUFE)
jobs.description:
What you will be working on

The YUFE Alliance is looking for a motivated Communications and Monitoring Officer that will have the opportunity to:

• Take part in the daily operations of the YUFE Central Office in Brussels
• Manage and maintain the website, including content development, monitoring and contact with web developers
• Coordinate the implementation of the YUFE seed funding, including communication and dissemination, support to applicants, selection process and committee, as well as follow-up and iteration of the scheme
• Keep up to date the contact database and distribution lists for YUFE communications
• Support market analysis on our joint educational offers 
• Support our communications content planning, delivery, monitoring and reporting
• Assist in the planning and execution of meetings and events
• Assist in project management tasks such as reporting and dissemination 
What we are looking for

We are looking for a dedicated, proactive team player that wants to contribute to a dynamic team within an international and intercultural environment. As equity, diversity and inclusivity belong to YUFE's core values, we are searching for a colleague fully committed to these principles.

• Ideal start date: January 2027
• You hold a master's degree
• At least 3 years of working experience in a Communications/Dissemination based role or similar
• Good knowledge of MS Office package (experience with SharePoint and Exact Online), Mailchimp, Canva, WordPress, experience with CornerStone is an asset
• You are strong at planning and organisation 
• You have excellent written and oral communication skills in English (any other European language will be an asset)
• You feel at ease to work independently, within a small team and are flexible to support a diverse range of tasks 
What we are offering 

• A contract of indefinite duration (under Belgian law)
• Salary based on experience (and orientated on salary scales of Belgian Universities)
• Competitive package of benefits (meal vouchers, full reimbursement of public transport, group insurance, etc.) 
• An open working environment with attention to your work-life balance and up to 40 days of holidays
• The possibility of working from home two days a week 
• Broadening of your professional networks in Brussels and across the EU
